Fable-Future-State-SAND49.author: Written by Alyssa Trent
Fable-Future-State-SAND49.hook: A soldier returns from an off-world war and finds he is being hunted by the very corporation who sent him there.

Fable-Midnight-in-Paris-DUSK77.author: Written by Woody Allen
Fable-Midnight-in-Paris-DUSK77.hook: While on a trip to Paris with his fiancée's family, a nostalgic screenwriter finds himself mysteriously going back to the 1920s every day at midnight.
